title: Creamy Pork Tenderloin
ingredients:
Dry Rubbed Pork Tenderloin: Tuscon Herb from Hatfield
Grey Poupon Dejuon Mustard
1 Bag: Parmasean & Romano Cheese
1.5 Pints of Land O Lakes Heavy Wipping Cream (small)
instructions:
Preheat Oven to 375 degrees
Find your Glass Cake Pan
Grab your Tenderloin
Rub: Grey Poupon Dejuon Mustard on Tenderloin
Place into cake pan
Cut Tenderloin into pieces: 4 or 5 serving
Dump 1 Bag of cheese into cake pan
Pour 1.5 Pints of Heavy Wipping Cream  into cake pan
Place in oven and set timer for 45min.
notes:
great with rice and potatoes 
also bread
